_comment: Measured wall clock in seconds per test executable, used by tools/ci-test-shard.js to balance the CI shard matrix. per_push = the per-push filter (~[performance]~[perf]~[benchmark]~[!benchmark]~[long]); long = the [long]~[vorago-sweep] lane. Refresh from the 'Running:' timestamps of a CI Windows log, or from a Catch2 run with -d yes, whenever a suite grows; a stale entry only unbalances the shards, it never fails a run. Source: per_push from the windows-2022 runner, run 37910949575 (2026-10-09), where the serial lane timed out inside vorago_tests at 134 s - its entry is the local 446 s halved, the ratio the other suites showed between that runner and a 32-core box running 15 suites at once; long from the Phase 13d close lanes on that box.
